issues.description: The template and problem statement use the BSS symbol display_start as the base address of the framebuffer, but the solution's .bss declares the buffer as screen_buffer while the solution's code still references display_start. This mismatched identifier means the solution refers to an undeclared symbol (display_start) and the declared symbol (screen_buffer) is never used, which will confuse students and cause assembler/linker errors or unexpected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent identifier for the framebuffer across all artifacts. Either (A) rename the solution's BSS declaration from screen_buffer to display_start to match the template and problem statement, or (B) update the template and problem statement to refer to screen_buffer instead of display_start. Ensure all references in set_pixel and main use the same symbol so the assembler finds the variable.
